judge.rationale: The implementation is a near-perfect realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the access decision in a single, readable expression using `matrix.get(role, set())` which correctly defaults to deny when the role is absent. The log entry is unconditionally appended before the return, ensuring no short-circuit path can bypass the audit record. The log record contains exactly the required fields (role, permission, allowed) and nothing extraneous. The code is flat, explicit, and locally auditable in five lines with no hidden control flow, no abstraction layers, and no architectural slop.
